popupCardConfirmTitle.description: Popup heading: a card is about to be filled on a page; the user confirms each card fill.

popupCardConfirmText.description: Popup question before a card fill. $CARD$ is the card (its name and last four digits), $SITE$ the website.

popupThisCard.description: Stands for a card whose name is unknown, inside "Fill $CARD$ on $SITE$?".

popupCrossConfirmTitle.message: Fill a login of another site?
popupCrossConfirmTitle.description: Popup heading: the user picked a login saved for another website to fill on this page.

popupCrossConfirmText.description: Confirmation under "Fill a login of another site?": $LOGIN$ is saved for another site; fill it on the page's site only if the user trusts it.

popupLookalikeTag.description: Popup, small red tag on a search result (a login of another site) when the open page's address looks like that login's site but is a different site (a possible phishing copy).

popupLookalikeHint.message: $HOST$ looks like $SITE$ but is a different site.
popupLookalikeHint.description: Tooltip of the "Lookalike site" tag: $HOST$ is the open page, $SITE$ the user's site it looks like.

popupLookalikeTitle.message: This may be a fake site
popupLookalikeTitle.description: Popup heading before a login is filled or copied on a page whose address looks like the login's site but is a different site.

popupLookalikeFillText.message: $HOST$ is not $SITE$, but its address looks like it. Phishing sites do this to steal logins. Fill your login only if you are sure this is the right site.
popupLookalikeFillText.description: Under "This may be a fake site" before filling: $HOST$ is the open page, $SITE$ the user's site it looks like.

popupLookalikeCopyText.message: $HOST$ is not $SITE$, but its address looks like it. Phishing sites do this to steal logins. Copy your login only if you are sure this is the right site.
popupLookalikeCopyText.description: Under "This may be a fake site" before copying a password or 2FA code: $HOST$ is the open page, $SITE$ the user's site it looks like.

popupLookalikeFillButton.description: Button under "This may be a fake site": fill the login on this page all the same.

popupLookalikeCopyButton.description: Button under "This may be a fake site": copy the password or 2FA code all the same.

popupIntlHost.description: Popup, quiet note over the list when the open page's address has international letters (shown in its xn-- form, $HOST$). Not a warning: most such sites are real.

bannerLookalike.message: $HOST$ is not $SITE$, but its address looks like it. Save only if you trust this site.
bannerLookalike.description: Save banner, red note when the page's address looks like a site the user has a login for but is a different site: $HOST$ is the page, $SITE$ the user's site.

commonIntlAddress.description: Save banner, quiet note under the site when its address has international letters (xn--). Not a warning: most such sites are real.

passkeyBrowserVaultTitle.message: Passkeys need the Passyble app for now
passkeyBrowserVaultTitle.description: Heading of the passkey card when the vault is kept in this browser (passkeys come later there).

welcomeVaultHeading.description: Setup guide: heading of the part where the user chooses where the vault is and sets it up.

welcomeChoiceExisting.message: Use the vault in this browser
welcomeChoiceExisting.description: Setup guide choice: a vault created or opened in this browser earlier is still here.

welcomeRepeatPassword.description: Setup guide: label of the second master password field.

welcomeCreateWarning.message: Passyble can't reset your master password. Write it down.
welcomeCreateWarning.description: Warning box when creating a vault in the browser: a forgotten master password cannot be recovered. Keep it this short.

welcomeCreateButton.description: Setup guide: button that creates the vault in this browser.

welcomeVaultFile.description: Setup guide: label of the file picker for a vault file.

welcomeOpenButton.description: Setup guide: button that opens the chosen vault file with its master password.

welcomeVaultReadyTitle.description: Setup guide: the vault in this browser is set up.

welcomeUseBrowserInstead.message: Keep a vault in this browser instead
welcomeUseBrowserInstead.description: Setup guide, link under the app checklist: keep a vault in this browser instead of using the Passyble app.

vaultMasterTooShort.description: New master password (Create a vault in this browser), refused: shorter than the minimum. $MIN$ is a number (12).

vaultMasterCommon.message: This is one of the most common passwords. Choose something else.
vaultMasterCommon.description: New master password, refused: it is on the list of the most common passwords (also with capitals, digits or symbols added).

vaultMasterContainsName.message: Leave out your e-mail address, username and the vault's name.
vaultMasterContainsName.description: New master password, refused: it is built from the user's e-mail address, username or the vault's name.

vaultMasterPattern.message: Avoid repeated characters, sequences like abcd or 1234 and keyboard rows like qwerty.
vaultMasterPattern.description: New master password, refused: it has repeated characters, sequences or keyboard rows. Keep the examples abcd, 1234 and qwerty (or the local keyboard's first letters).

vaultMasterGuessable.message: Too easy to guess. Add more words or random characters: four or more unrelated words work well.
vaultMasterGuessable.description: New master password, refused: not strong enough for a master password, with how to fix it.

vaultMasterStrongEnough.message: $STRENGTH$: strong enough for a master password.
vaultMasterStrongEnough.description: New master password, accepted. $STRENGTH$ is the strength word (vaultStrengthOk or vaultStrengthStrong).

vaultStrengthOk.description: Master password strength word: good (the start of vaultMasterStrongEnough).

vaultStrengthStrong.description: Master password strength word: strong (the start of vaultMasterStrongEnough).

welcomePasswordsDiffer.message: The passwords don't match. Type them again.
welcomePasswordsDiffer.description: Setup guide error: the two master password fields differ.

welcomeCreating.description: Setup guide status while the vault is created.

welcomeVaultExists.message: There is a vault in this browser already. Use it, or delete it in Settings first.
welcomeVaultExists.description: Setup guide error: a vault is kept in this browser already.

welcomePickFile.description: Setup guide error: "Open vault" without a file chosen.

welcomeNotVaultFile.message: This isn't a Passyble vault file.
welcomeNotVaultFile.description: Setup guide error: the chosen file is not a vault file.

optionsVaultModeHeading.description: Settings heading: where the vault is (this browser or the Passyble app), with the vault in this browser's settings under it.

optionsVaultHeading.description: Options: heading of the settings of the vault kept in this browser.

optionsAutoLock.description: Options row label (short): lock the vault after this much time without use.

optionsAutoLockDetails.message: Always locks when the browser closes.
optionsAutoLockDetails.description: Tooltip of "Lock after" (the vault in the browser).

optionsAutoLockMinutes.description: Options: a choice of "Lock after", in minutes (abbreviated). $COUNT$ is a number.

optionsAutoLockBrowserClose.description: Options: a choice of "Lock after": no timer, it locks when the browser closes.

optionsLockOnIdle.description: Options row label (short): lock the vault when the computer is locked.

optionsVerifyEachFill.description: Options row label (short): ask for the master password before each fill.

optionsVerifyEachFillDetails.message: Asks for your master password each time.
optionsVerifyEachFillDetails.description: Tooltip of "Confirm each fill": each fill or copy of a password needs the master password.

optionsDeleteVault.description: Settings row (the vault in this browser): delete it, after a backup and the master password.

optionsDelete.description: Options button: starts deleting the vault in this browser (asks first).

optionsDeleteWarn.message: Deletes the vault in this browser for good.
optionsDeleteWarn.description: Warning above the master password field when deleting the vault in the browser.

optionsMasterTipBody.message: Your master password is easier to guess than Passyble now allows for new ones. It still works.
optionsMasterTipBody.description: Calm tip in Settings (vault in this browser) when the master password used to unlock was set before the current master password rule. Not an error; the user can dismiss it.

optionsDeleteForGood.description: Options button: deletes the vault in this browser permanently.

optionsDeleted.description: Options notice after the vault in this browser was deleted.

optionsModeBrowser.description: Options: the vault is kept in this browser.

optionsModeApp.description: Settings, "Where your vault is": the extension fills from the Passyble app on this computer.

optionsModeBrowserLocked.description: Settings, "Where your vault is": the vault in this browser is locked.

optionsModeBrowserUnlocked.description: Settings, "Where your vault is": the vault in this browser is unlocked.

optionsModeBrowserNone.description: Settings, "Where your vault is": browser mode, but no vault was created or opened yet.

optionsUseApp.description: Button, Settings "Where your vault is": switch to the Passyble app (the vault in this browser stays, locked).

optionsUseBrowserVault.message: Use a vault in this browser
optionsUseBrowserVault.description: Button, Settings "Where your vault is": switch to a vault kept in this browser (or create one in the setup guide).

welcomeGetApp.description: Setup page choice (on Windows): download the Passyble app for Windows instead of keeping the vault in the browser.

optionsShortcutChange.description: Settings, Shortcuts card: opens the browser's keyboard shortcuts page for extensions.

accountSignIn.description: Button (setup page, Settings): sign in to an existing Passyble account on the Passyble website. Low-key; nothing about plans or prices.

accountSignOut.description: Button in Settings: sign this browser out of the Passyble account.

accountTitle.description: Settings row (About): the optional Passyble account, next to a "Sign in" button.

accountSignedInAs.description: The Passyble account this browser is signed in to (setup page, Settings).

accountSignInFailed.description: Error after "Sign in": the website sign-in or the token exchange failed (closing the sign-in window is no error).

accountCloudSoon.message: Passyble Cloud storage is coming soon.
accountCloudSoon.description: Setup: one line shown after signing in to the Passyble account. Storage of the vault in Passyble Cloud (the company's own cloud) is not available yet. "Passyble Cloud" is a product name.

accountUseDrive.description: Setup: button under the "coming soon" line: use Google Drive for the vault instead.

accountViaApp.message: Signed in through the Passyble app on this computer
accountViaApp.description: Settings and setup page, under the account's e-mail address: the Passyble desktop app on this computer signed this browser extension in to the same Passyble account (no separate sign-in in the browser).

accountSignOutAppToo.message: Also sign out of the Passyble app on this computer
accountSignOutAppToo.description: Checkbox in the confirmation after "Sign out" (Settings), ticked by default: the Passyble desktop app on this computer, signed in to the same account, signs out too. Unticked: only the browser extension signs out.

accountOtherInBrowser.message: The Passyble app is signed in as $APP$; this browser as $BROWSER$.
accountOtherInBrowser.description: Settings, under the account row: the Passyble desktop app on this computer is signed in to one Passyble account and this browser extension still holds a sign-in of its own to another (made while the app could not be reached). APP and BROWSER are e-mail addresses.

accountUseAppAccount.description: Settings, button under the note that the Passyble app and this browser are signed in to different accounts: this browser forgets its own sign-in and uses the app's account.

optionsDownloadCopy.description: Options row: download a copy of the encrypted vault file.

vaultCopySaved.description: Options: short confirmation after the vault file was downloaded.

popupLockedText.message: Unlock to fill your logins on this site.

popupNoVaultText.message: Create a vault in this browser, or use the Passyble app for Google Drive sync.
popupNoVaultText.description: Popup, browser mode with no vault yet: what the user can do.

optionsShortcutsLead.message: Keys that work on any page in this browser.

optionsAboutLead.message: This extension and the Passyble app it works with.

welcomeChoiceAppText.message: Your vault stays in the Passyble app on this PC.

welcomeAllSetLead.message: Passyble fills your logins in this browser. Click its icon in the toolbar any time.

optionsAppRowText.description: Settings: the caption of the "Passyble app" row (its button: Use the app).

commonOr.description: The small word between two ways of doing the same thing (Windows Hello, or the master password).

welcomeRecommended.description: Setup guide: the small chip on the recommended choice (Google Drive).

passkeySaveShort.description: Title of the in-page card that saves a new passkey (the site and account are on the line under it).

serverAddressLabel.description: The label above the Passyble Server field (popup and Settings).

welcomeStepOf.description: Setup guide: the line over the checklist (which step the user is on).

optionsLocking.description: Settings, the vault in this browser: the label over the card of when the vault locks.

optionsDownloadCopyText.description: Settings: the caption of "Download a copy" (what the file is).

optionsSaveFile.description: Settings: the button of the "Download a copy" row (saves the encrypted vault file).

passkeySaveVaultNamed.description: In-page passkey card: the vault it goes to, when its name already ends in "vault" ("In Work vault"). Otherwise passkeySaveVault.

updateRequiredText.description: Popup, forced update: under "Update required". Until it is updated the extension only shows and copies passwords.

updateNow.description: Popup, forced update and "new version" banner: button that updates the extension (the browser's own update, else its store page).

updateViewPasswords.description: Popup, forced update: button that opens the read-only vault (search and copy only).

updateReadOnlyNote.message: The Passyble extension is read-only until you update it. You can still view and copy your passwords.

updateAvailable.message: A new version of Passyble is available.

updateChecking.description: Popup, forced update: shown after "Update" while the browser looks for the new version.

updateInstalling.description: Popup, forced update: the browser found the new version; the extension restarts with it (the popup closes).

updateSearchHint.message: Type at least 2 characters to find a login.
updateSearchHint.description: Popup, read-only vault: under the empty search field.

errAppUpdateRequired.message: Update the Passyble app to keep filling.

errExtensionUpdateRequired.message: Update the Passyble extension to keep filling.
errExtensionUpdateRequired.description: Error: this browser extension is older than the minimum version and is read-only until it is updated.

driveNeedsAppText.description: Setup guide, under "Google Drive sync needs the Passyble app on this computer": how it works.

driveNeedsAppMove.message: To take the vault of this browser along, download a copy in Settings and open it in the Passyble app.

driveNeedsAppShort.message: Google Drive sync needs the app

driveRecordText.message: This vault synced with Google Drive in an older version. It keeps working in this browser; to sync it again, use the Passyble app.
driveRecordText.description: Setup guide and Settings: a vault that an older version of the extension synced with Google Drive itself. It still works locally.

driveDownloadApp.description: Button (a link to passyble.com/download): get the Passyble desktop app.

driveCheckAgain.description: Button: look again whether the Passyble desktop app is installed on this computer.

driveAppFound.message: The Passyble app is on this computer. Use it, then turn on Google Drive in the app.
driveAppFound.description: Setup guide, after "Check again": the Passyble desktop app was found.

driveAppMissing.message: The Passyble app isn't on this computer yet.
driveAppMissing.description: Setup guide, after "Check again": the Passyble desktop app was not found.

driveTurnOnInApp.message: For Google Drive sync, open Settings in the Passyble app, then Sync, and turn on Google Drive.
driveTurnOnInApp.description: Setup guide, the app checklist: where Google Drive sync is turned on (in the desktop app; "Settings" and "Sync" are its menu names).

welcomeChoiceCreate.description: Setup guide choice: make a new vault kept only in this browser.

welcomeChoiceCreateText.message: Kept only on this device. No app needed.
welcomeChoiceCreateText.description: Setup guide, under "Create a vault in this browser".

welcomeChoiceOpen.description: Setup guide choice and heading: open a .vault file (a copy from another device, or a backup) in this browser.

welcomeChoiceOpenText.message: A copy from another device, or a backup.
welcomeChoiceOpenText.description: Setup guide, under "Open a vault file".

localOnlyTitle.message: This vault is only on this device
localOnlyTitle.description: Reminder title: the vault has no sync and no backup, it exists only on this device.

localOnlyBody.description: Reminder text under "This vault is only on this device". "Google Drive" is a product name.

localOnlyCreateNotice.message: Only on this device. If you lose this device you lose these passwords. You can turn on Google Drive backup now or later.

localOnlySetUpSync.description: Button on the "only on this device" reminder: set up sync or backup for this vault.

localOnlyNotNow.description: Button on the "only on this device" reminder: hide it for 30 days.

localOnlyDetails.description: Popup, (i) button on the "only on this device" reminder: shows or hides its explanation. Tooltip and screen reader label.

errFillOnly.message: This login can be filled but not shown or copied.
errFillOnly.description: Error: a fill-only member's login; its password is filled into pages but never shown or copied.

bannerSaveIn.description: Save banner and passkey card: label of the list of vaults a new login can go into (Teams and Family).

bannerMyVault.description: The user's own vault (the home vault) in lists of vaults, when it has no name of its own.

bannerInVault.description: Save banner, updating a login of a shared vault: which vault it is in. $VAULT$ is the vault's name.

popupUnpinVault.description: Popup: a pinned vault row's context menu in the Filter menu or the vault switcher: take its pin off.

popupFilter.description: Popup: the Filter button next to the search box while the list shows everything, and the name of its menu (vaults and kinds of item).

popupVaultPinned.description: Popup: what a screen reader hears after a pinned vault's name in a vault list.

popupNoLoginsInVault.message: No logins for this site in $VAULT$

popupSwitchVault.description: Popup header: tooltip of the vault switcher (the user's own vaults in the Passyble app), and the name of its menu.

popupSwitchUnlockInApp.description: Popup, after switching vaults: the Passyble app now asks to unlock the vault chosen (Windows Hello or the master password there). $VAULT$ is its name.

popupMovedTo.description: Popup notice: the login was moved to another vault. $VAULT$ is that vault's name.

editorVault.description: Popup login editor: label of the list of vaults the login can be moved to.

teamsOpenConsole.description: Popup button (browser vault, admins): opens the Team's or Family's console on the Passyble website.

teamsRuleSecondTitle.message: Your team requires a second password
teamsRuleSecondTitle.description: Popup notice title in the "Shared with me" area: the user's team requires a second password (the vault in this browser opening with its own password, separate from the Passyble password), and this browser doesn't meet it.

teamsRuleSecondBrowser.message: This browser can't give its vault a second password, so you can use this team's items here but not change them. Use the Passyble app on Windows or Android, or ask your team admin.
teamsRuleSecondBrowser.description: Popup notice under that title (browser mode): the team's shared vaults are read-only in this browser until the rule is met, which this browser can't do itself; where it can be done.

teamsRuleOneTitle.description: Popup notice title in the "Shared with me" area: the user's team allows only the Passyble password, but the vault in this browser still has its own password.

teamsRuleOneBrowser.message: $VAULT$ still has its own password, and this browser can't switch it to your Passyble password. Use the Passyble app on Windows or Android, or ask your team admin.
teamsRuleOneBrowser.description: Popup notice under that title (browser mode). $VAULT$ is the name of the vault in this browser ("Personal").

teamsConfirm.description: Button: confirm a person's sharing keys after comparing the fingerprint with them.

teamsConfirmHint.message: Ask them to read the fingerprint from their Passyble app, then type it here.
teamsConfirmHint.description: Under a person to confirm: how to compare their fingerprint.

teamsConfirmTyped.description: Accessible name of the fingerprint field. $PERSON$ is an e-mail address.

teamsConfirmed.description: Notice after a confirmation. $PERSON$ is an e-mail address.

teamsConfirmList.description: Accessible name of the list of people waiting for confirmation.

teamsKeysChanged.message: $PERSON$'s keys changed. Compare the new fingerprint with $PERSON$ before giving access.
teamsKeysChanged.description: Loud warning: the keys the account service gives for a person are not the ones the user verified (or the person has new keys). $PERSON$ is an e-mail address.

teamsLeftOut.message: Compare the fingerprint with $PERSON$ to give access.
teamsLeftOut.description: Notice: a person was left out of a shared vault because the user has not verified their keys on this device yet. $PERSON$ is an e-mail address.

teamsFingerprintMismatch.message: That fingerprint doesn't match. Compare it again with the person.
teamsFingerprintMismatch.description: Error: the fingerprint the user typed or compared is not the one of these keys.

teamsKeysWrong.message: The keys the service sent don't match this fingerprint. Nothing was changed.
teamsKeysWrong.description: Error: the keys the account service sent for a person are not the keys of the fingerprint. Nothing changed.

teamsSignerList.description: Accessible name of the list of shared vaults whose manager the user has not verified yet.

teamsSignerUnverified.description: A shared vault whose manager's keys the user has not verified yet. $VAULT$ is the vault's name.

teamsSignerHint.message: Ask the manager who shared it to read their fingerprint from their Passyble app. Verify only if it is this one:
teamsSignerHint.description: Under a shared vault to verify, before the manager's fingerprint.

teamsSignerChanged.description: Loud warning: the keys of the manager who signed a shared vault's members list are not the ones the user verified. $VAULT$ is the vault's name.

teamsSignerChangedHint.message: These are not the keys you verified. Don't rely on this vault until you compare the new fingerprint with the manager:
teamsSignerChangedHint.description: Under the warning that a shared vault's manager has other keys, before the new fingerprint.

teamsSignerVerify.description: Button: the fingerprint the manager read out is the one shown; verifies the manager's keys.

teamsSignerVerified.description: Notice after the user verified the manager of a shared vault. $VAULT$ is the vault's name.

teamsLineHeld_one.description: Popup line: shared vaults held until this browser signs in as the organisation requires. $COUNT$ is a number. Singular form.

teamsLineHeld_other.description: Popup line: shared vaults held until this browser signs in as the organisation requires. $COUNT$ is a number. Plural form.

teamsLineDeviceWaiting.message: this browser waits for approval on another device
teamsLineDeviceWaiting.description: Popup line: this browser's Passyble Cloud device waits until another device of the account approves it.

optionsHelpSupport.description: Settings, About: the row that opens the Passyble support page (the desktop app's support screen, or the web form).

popupHelpSupport.description: Popup, More menu: opens the Passyble support page (the desktop app's support screen, or the web form).

popupPassyblePassword.description: Placeholder and label of the password field for a vault linked to a Passyble account: the one password of the account, which opens its linked vaults.

popupUnlockEmptyAccount.description: Error: Unlock or Sign in was pressed with an empty Passyble password field.

accountEmailAddress.description: Label and placeholder of the field for the Passyble account's e-mail address.

accountSecretKey.description: Label of the Secret Key field. The Secret Key is a code made on the device at sign-up, printed in the Emergency Kit, starting with P1. Keep the name as the Passyble apps translate it.

accountSecretKeyPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the Secret Key field in the popup. Keep P1 as it is.

accountSecretKeyHint.message: Only once in this browser. It's in your Emergency Kit.
accountSecretKeyHint.description: Under the Secret Key field: it is asked only the first time in this browser profile; the Emergency Kit is the page the Passyble app printed at sign-up.

accountSharedComputer.message: This is a shared computer: don't keep my Secret Key
accountSharedComputer.description: Checkbox beside the Secret Key field: when ticked, this browser doesn't keep the Secret Key, so it is asked again next time.

accountApproveFromDevice.description: Link and heading: sign this browser in with the help of a phone or computer already signed in to the Passyble account (it scans a QR code or compares a 6-digit code).

accountPageTitle.description: Title of the page where the user signs in with the Passyble password or approves this browser from another device.

accountPageLead.message: One password for your Passyble account and the vaults linked to it. It never leaves this browser.
accountPageLead.description: Lead under the Passyble password page title.

accountKeysInApp.message: The Passyble app on this computer opens your vaults with your Passyble password. Sign in there.
accountKeysInApp.description: Passyble password page while the extension uses the Passyble app on this computer (app mode): nothing to do in the browser.

accountPasswordSignIn.message: Sign in with your Passyble password
accountPasswordSignIn.description: Heading of the Passyble password sign-in form (e-mail address, password, the Secret Key the first time).

accountSigningIn.description: Status while the Passyble password sign-in runs.

accountSignedInUnlocked.message: Signed in as $EMAIL$. Your vault in this browser is unlocked.
accountSignedInUnlocked.description: After a Passyble password sign-in or an approval that also opened the vault linked to the account.

accountApproveLead.message: Use a phone or computer where you're signed in to Passyble. Nothing to type but your e-mail address.

accountApproveAsk.description: Button: this browser asks the account's other devices to approve it (then shows a QR code).

accountApproveQrLabel.message: QR code for your other device
accountApproveQrLabel.description: Screen reader label of the QR code the other device scans to approve this browser.

accountApproveQrHint.message: On your other device, open Passyble and add a device, then scan this code. No camera? Approve this browser there and type the code shown here.
accountApproveQrHint.description: Under the QR another device scans to approve this browser. Without a camera, the other device approves and the user types the code this browser shows.

accountApproveCodeHint.message: Type this code on your other device.
accountApproveCodeHint.description: Above the 6-digit code this browser shows; the user types it on the other device to approve this browser.

accountApproveCheckHint.message: Check that your other device shows this fingerprint in Settings, Passyble password.
accountApproveCheckHint.description: Above the account key fingerprint that arrived from the other device. "Settings, Passyble password" is where the other device's app shows its fingerprint.

accountApproveFingerprintLabel.description: Accessible name of the account key fingerprint shown for the check.

accountApproveMatches.description: Button: the other device shows the same fingerprint; the keys are kept.

accountApproveNoMatch.description: Button: the other device shows another fingerprint; the keys are dropped.

accountApproveNotKept.message: The keys were not kept. A fingerprint that doesn't match means they may not be your account's keys. Ask again from your other device, and contact support if it happens again.
accountApproveNotKept.description: Loud warning after "It doesn't match": the keys that arrived were dropped, they may not be the account's.

accountApproveCancelledNotKept.message: Cancelled. The keys that arrived were not kept.
accountApproveCancelledNotKept.description: Warning after Cancel while the arrived keys waited for the fingerprint check: they were dropped.

accountApproveWaiting.description: Status while this browser waits for the approval.

accountApproveDone.message: This browser is approved. Your Passyble password opens your linked vaults here.
accountApproveDone.description: After the other device approved this browser (the account key and the Secret Key arrived).

accountApproveDoneUnlocked.message: This browser is approved, and your vault in this browser is unlocked.
accountApproveDoneUnlocked.description: After the approval also opened the vault in this browser that is linked to the account.

accountApproveDenied.message: Your other device said no. Start again if that was a mistake.
accountApproveDenied.description: The other device denied the approval.

accountApproveExpired.message: The request ended. Ask again to approve this browser.
accountApproveExpired.description: The approval request expired (10 minutes) or is gone.

accountKeysAppOnly.message: Change your Passyble password, your Secret Key or your recovery code in the Passyble app.
accountKeysAppOnly.description: Note at the bottom of the Passyble password page: those changes are app-only.

accountPasswordButton.description: Settings, Account row: opens the page to sign in with the Passyble password or approve this browser from another device.

welcomeChoicePassword.description: Setup guide choice: open the page to sign in with the Passyble password or approve this browser from another device.

welcomeChoicePasswordText.message: Sign in here, or approve this browser from another device.
welcomeChoicePasswordText.description: Caption of "Use your Passyble password" in the setup guide.

errWrongAccountPassword.message: Wrong Passyble password or Secret Key. Is Caps Lock on?
errWrongAccountPassword.description: Error: the Passyble password and the Secret Key don't open the account key.

errPasswordLimited.message: Too many wrong passwords. Wait a while, then try again.
errPasswordLimited.description: Error: the account service refuses password tries for this address for a while.

errAccountKeysOff.message: The Passyble password isn't available yet.
errAccountKeysOff.description: Error: the account service doesn't take the Passyble password yet.

errNoAccountPassword.message: This account has no Passyble password yet. Set one in the Passyble app.
errNoAccountPassword.description: Error: the account has no Passyble password; it is set in an app.

errAccountService.message: The Passyble account service didn't answer as expected. Try again later.
errAccountService.description: Error: an unexpected answer of account.passyble.com.

errAccountOffline.message: Can't reach your Passyble account. Check your internet connection and try again.

errAccountSignedOut.message: Sign in to your Passyble account first.
errAccountSignedOut.description: Error: this step needs the browser signed in to the Passyble account.

errBadSecretKey.message: That isn't a Secret Key. Copy it from your Emergency Kit: it starts with P1.
errBadSecretKey.description: Error: what was typed as the Secret Key isn't one (a recovery code is not a Secret Key).

errSecretKeyNeeded.message: Enter your Secret Key once in this browser. It's in your Emergency Kit.
errSecretKeyNeeded.description: Error: this browser keeps no Secret Key for the account yet (the in-page menu says to use the popup).

errEmailNeeded.description: Error: the Passyble account's e-mail address is needed.

errOtherAccount.message: This password is for another Passyble account than this vault.
errOtherAccount.description: Error: the password signed in to a different account than the one the vault is linked to.

errOtherAccountKey.message: This vault is linked to an older key of your account. Open it in the Passyble app once.
errOtherAccountKey.description: Error: the vault was linked with an account key that was replaced since.

errApprovalMismatch.message: The approval didn't match. Start again on both devices.
errApprovalMismatch.description: Error: the keys the other device sent don't open here.

accountSecretKeyExample.description: Placeholder of the Secret Key field: the shape of a Secret Key. Keep P1 and the dashes; X may be any letter your language uses for an unknown character.

qaGroupLabel.description: Accessible name of the popup's row of quick action buttons (Scan QR, New note, Generate).

qaScanQr.description: Quick action button in the popup (keep it short): finds an authenticator (2FA) QR code on the current page and adds it.

qaScanQrTitle.message: Add the 2FA QR code shown on this page
qaScanQrTitle.description: Tooltip of the Scan QR quick action.

qaNewNote.description: Quick action button in the popup (keep it short): opens a small editor for a secure note.

qaNewNoteTitle.message: Add a secure note, such as recovery codes
qaNewNoteTitle.description: Tooltip of the New note quick action.

qaGenerate.description: Quick action button in the popup (keep it short): generates a strong password to copy.

qaGenerateTitle.description: Tooltip of the Generate quick action.

qaNoQr.message: No QR code visible on this page. Scroll it into view and try again.
qaNoQr.description: Notice after Scan QR: no QR code was in the visible part of the page.

qaNotAuthenticator.message: This QR code isn't for an authenticator app.
qaNotAuthenticator.description: Notice after Scan QR: the page has a QR code, but not one for 2FA codes.

qaMigration.message: This QR code is a Google Authenticator export. Import it in the Passyble app.
qaMigration.description: Notice after Scan QR: the QR code moves several codes out of Google Authenticator; the extension can't take it, the desktop app's import can.

qaHotp.message: This QR code is for counter-based codes (HOTP), which Passyble doesn't support.
qaHotp.description: Notice after Scan QR: the QR code is for HOTP (counter-based) codes; only time-based codes are supported. Keep "HOTP".

qaInvalidQr.message: This 2FA QR code can't be read. Add the code with its secret key instead.
qaInvalidQr.description: Notice after Scan QR: the 2FA QR code is broken or incomplete; the user can paste the secret in the login editor instead.

qaAddTotpHeading.description: Heading of the view after Scan QR found a 2FA code: where to add it.

qaUnnamedCode.description: Name shown for a scanned 2FA code whose QR code names no service or account.

qaAddTo.description: Label over the choice of login (or a new login) the scanned 2FA code is added to.

qaHasTotp.description: Small tag on a login that already has a 2FA code (adding the scanned one replaces it).

qaNewLoginFor.description: Choice after Scan QR: save the 2FA code as a new login for the current site.

qaThisSite.description: Stands in for the site name in "New login for this site" when the page has no host name.

qaPickHint.message: Choose the login to add it to.
qaPickHint.description: Hint after Scan QR when several logins of the site could take the code and none is chosen yet.

qaReplacesTotp.message: Its current 2FA code will be replaced.
qaReplacesTotp.description: Note under the choice after Scan QR: the chosen login already has a 2FA code.

qaAddTotp.description: Button: add the scanned 2FA code to the chosen login.

qaTotpAdded.description: Notice: the scanned 2FA code was added to that login.

qaTotpSavedNew.description: Notice: the scanned 2FA code was saved as a new login with that title.

qaNoteHeading.description: Heading of the popup's small secure note editor.

qaNoteTitle.description: Label of the secure note's title field.

qaNoteText.description: Label of the secure note's text field.

qaNoteTextPlaceholder.message: Paste recovery codes or write a note
qaNoteTextPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the secure note's text field.

qaNoteRecovery.description: Title suggestion (a small button) in the secure note editor, and the note's title when the page has no site name.

qaNoteRecoveryFor.description: The title the "Recovery codes" suggestion fills in, with the current site.

qaNoteUntitled.description: Placeholder of the note's title field, and the title of a note saved without one.

qaNoteHint.message: Saved as a secure note in your vault.
qaNoteHint.description: Note under the secure note editor: where the note is kept.

qaNoteSaved.description: Notice after the secure note was saved.

qaNoteNeedsUpdate.message: Update Passyble to add notes here.
qaNoteNeedsUpdate.description: Notice: this Passyble app (or browser vault) is too old to save a note from the popup.

qaGenerateHeading.description: Heading of the popup's password generator view.

qaGeneratedLabel.description: Accessible name of the generated password shown in the generator view.

qaRegenerate.description: Tooltip of the button that generates another password.

qaGenerateHint.message: A copied password is cleared from the clipboard after 45 seconds.

vaultAppInstalledHere.message: The Passyble app is installed on this computer, so Passyble uses it here.
vaultAppInstalledHere.description: Options and the setup guide, app mode: why the vault in this browser isn't offered while the desktop app is installed.

optionsAppGone.message: The Passyble app is no longer on this computer. You can keep a vault in this browser instead.
optionsAppGone.description: Options, app mode: the desktop app was uninstalled (found missing several times). The button next to it offers the vault in this browser.

moveOffer_one.message: Move $COUNT$ item from this browser into the Passyble app
moveOffer_one.description: Popup tip and Options card after the extension switched to the desktop app: offer to move the vault kept in this browser (singular form).

moveOffer_other.message: Move $COUNT$ items from this browser into the Passyble app
moveOffer_other.description: Popup tip and Options card after the extension switched to the desktop app: offer to move the vault kept in this browser (plural form).

moveOfferAny.message: Move the items in this browser into the Passyble app
moveOfferAny.description: The same offer when the number of items isn't known (the vault in this browser was locked).

moveText.message: They stay in this browser too, until you delete the vault here.
moveText.description: Options, under the move offer: moving copies the items; nothing is removed from the browser.

moveStart.description: Options button: opens the form to move the browser's items into the desktop app.

moveConfirm.description: Button: move the items now (Options form, popup tip).

moveInto.description: Options move form: label of the list of the desktop app's vaults the items can go into.

moveMoving.description: Options move form: shown while the items are being moved.

moveDoneTitle.description: Options: every item of the vault in this browser is in the desktop app now.

moveDoneText.message: Added: $ADDED$. Already in the app: $SKIPPED$. The vault in this browser is kept until you delete it.
moveDoneText.description: Options, after the move: how many items were added and how many were there already (skipped as duplicates).

movePartialTitle.description: Options: the move added most items, but some failed.

movePartialText.message: Added: $ADDED$. Already in the app: $SKIPPED$. Could not move: $FAILED$. Those are still in this browser.
movePartialText.description: Options, after a move where some items failed; their titles are listed below it.

moveDeleteVault.message: Delete the vault in this browser
moveDeleteVault.description: Options button after a complete move: removes the vault kept in this browser.

moveDeleteWarn.message: Deletes the vault in this browser for good. Its items are in the Passyble app now.
moveDeleteWarn.description: Options: the confirmation before the vault in this browser is deleted after a move.

cardBannerSave.description: Card save prompt heading after paying with a card that isn't in Passyble yet.

cardBannerUpdate.description: Card save prompt heading: the card is in Passyble with another expiry date.

cardBannerSaved.description: Card save prompt status after saving a new card.

cardBannerUpdated.description: Card save prompt status after the saved card got the new expiry date.

cardBannerNoCode.message: The security code isn't saved. You can add it to the card in Passyble.
cardBannerNoCode.description: Card save prompt, a quiet line: the card's security code (CVV) is never saved from the page; the user can type it into the card in the Passyble app.

cardBannerNeverDone.message: Won't offer to save cards on this site.
cardBannerNeverDone.description: Card save prompt, after "Never for this site": Passyble won't offer to save cards on this site (the list is in Settings).

cardBannerEditFrameTitle.description: Accessible name of the card details box behind "Edit" in the card save prompt (an extension frame the website can't read).

cardEditHolder.description: Card save prompt, Edit: label of the cardholder name field.

cardEditExpiry.description: Card save prompt, Edit: label of the expiry date field.

cardEditExpiryPlaceholder.description: Card save prompt, Edit: placeholder of the expiry date field (month / two-digit year, as printed on cards).

cardEditExpiryHint.description: Card save prompt, Edit: the expiry date typed can't be read.

cardEditTitle.description: Card save prompt, Edit: label of the field for the card's name in Passyble (empty: brand and last four digits).

settingCardSave.description: Setting name: ask to save a payment card after paying with a new one.

settingCardSaveDetails.message: Asks to save a new card after you pay with it.
settingCardSaveDetails.description: Caption of the "Offer to save cards" setting.

optionsNeverSaveCards.description: Settings, "Never save" list: caption under a site where only cards are never offered to be saved.

menuSimilarSites.description: In-page menu and popup, a site without logins: heading over logins of other sites that may be this one (same name under another ending such as amazon.de for amazon.com, or the name in the title).

menuSearchPassyble.description: In-page menu, a site without logins: opens the Passyble popup to search the whole vault.

menuSearchUseToolbar.message: To search your vault, click Passyble in the browser toolbar.
menuSearchUseToolbar.description: Short notice when the browser does not let Passyble open its popup from the page.

commonNoLoginsFor.description: In-page menu and popup: nothing is saved for this site. $SITE$ is the site, e.g. amazon.co.uk.

crossTitle.description: Card after a login of another site was filled into this page: offer to use it for this site from now on. $SITE$ is this page's site.

crossSavedFor.description: Card after a login of another site was filled: the line under the title reads "<username> · saved for <site>". $SITE$ is the site the login was saved for.

crossAdd.description: Button: adds this page's site to the login's websites, so it fills here without asking next time.

crossCopy.description: Button: saves a separate login for this page's site with the same username and password.

crossHint.message: Adding it fills this login here without asking next time. A copy keeps the two separate.
crossHint.description: Small text under the buttons of that card: the difference between adding the site and saving a copy.

crossAdded.description: After "Add <site> to this login": done. $SITE$ is the page's site, $TITLE$ the login's title.

crossLookalike.message: $HOST$ is not $SITE$, but its address looks like it. Add it only if you trust this site.
crossLookalike.description: Red warning on that card when the page's address looks like the login's site without being it: $HOST$ is the page, $SITE$ the login's site.

changedTitle.description: Title of the card after the user changed the username or password Passyble filled, then signed in: offer to update the saved login.

changedUsername.description: A line on that card: the username was changed. $USERNAME$ is the new username or e-mail address.

changedPassword.description: A line on that card: the password was changed (the password itself is never shown).

changedFromSite.message: Saved for $SITE$. Updating it also adds $HOST$ to this login.
changedFromSite.description: Note on that card when the login was saved for another site: updating it also adds this page's site to it. $SITE$ is the login's site, $HOST$ this page.

changedReadOnly.message: This login is in a shared vault you can't change. You can save a new login instead.
changedReadOnly.description: Note on that card when the login is in a shared vault the user may not change: only a new login can be saved.

changedLookalike.message: $HOST$ is not $SITE$, but its address looks like it. Update or save only if you trust this site.
changedLookalike.description: Red warning on that card when the page's address looks like the login's site without being it: $HOST$ is the page, $SITE$ the login's site.

changedUpdate.description: Button on that card: save the changes to the login that was filled.

changedSaveNew.description: Button on that card: keep the filled login as it is and save what was typed as a separate login.

changedSavedNew.description: Status after "Save as new login": done.

popupTypeFilter.description: Popup, Filter menu: what a screen reader hears for its Show section, which narrows the list to one kind of item.

popupTypeAll.description: Popup, type filter chip: every kind of item.

popupTypeLogins.description: Popup, type filter chip: only logins (not cards or addresses).

popupTypeCards.description: Popup, type filter chip: only payment cards.

popupTypeAddresses.description: Popup, type filter chip: only addresses (identities).

popupTypeFavorites.description: Popup, type filter chip: only items marked as favorites (logins, cards, addresses, notes).

popupTypeNotes.description: Popup, type filter chip: only secure notes.

popupSecureNotes.description: Popup: heading of the list of secure notes (the Notes and Favorites filters).

popupSecureNote.description: Popup: the line under a secure note's title in the list.

popupShowNote.description: Popup: tooltip of a secure note's row (opens the note and shows its text).

popupShowNoteOf.description: Popup: accessible name of a secure note's row (opens the note).

popupCopyNote.description: Popup: button that copies the text of a secure note.

popupCopyNoteOf.description: Popup: accessible name of the copy button of a secure note's row.

popupCopiedNote.description: Notice after copying a secure note's text.

popupCopiedNoteClears.description: Notice after copying a secure note's text; the clipboard is cleared after 45 seconds.

popupNoteEmpty.description: Popup: a secure note without text (in its viewer, or after Copy).

popupNoteText.description: Popup: accessible name of a secure note's text in its viewer.

popupNoFilterMatches.description: Popup: empty state when the type filter chosen leaves nothing to show.

ctxSaveSelection.description: Right-click menu entry on selected text: add the selection to a secure note.

clipHeading.description: Title of the small window that adds the selected text to a secure note.

clipSelection.description: Accessible name of the preview of the selected text in the note chooser.

clipAddAddress.description: Checkbox in the note chooser: add the web page's address under the selected text.

clipSearch.description: Placeholder and accessible name of the search box over the secure notes in the note chooser.

clipNewNote.description: Row in the note chooser: save the selected text as a new secure note.

clipNotes.description: Accessible name of the list of secure notes in the note chooser.

clipSaveNew.description: Button: save the selected text as a new secure note with the title above.

clipAdded.description: Notice: the selected text was added as a new line at the end of that secure note.

clipSavedNew.description: Notice: the selected text was saved as a new secure note.

clipNoNotes.message: No notes yet. Save it as a new note.
clipNoNotes.description: Note chooser without any secure notes.

clipNoMatch.description: Note chooser: no secure note title matches the search.

clipViewOnly.description: Under a note of a shared vault the user may view but not change, in the note chooser.

clipLockedText.message: Unlock to add the selection to a note.
clipLockedText.description: Locked view of the note chooser, under "Passyble is locked".

clipAppendNeedsUpdate.message: Update the Passyble app to add to a note.
clipAppendNeedsUpdate.description: The desktop app is too old to add text to an existing note (a new note still works).

clipNeedsUpdate.message: Update the Passyble app to save notes from the browser.
clipNeedsUpdate.description: The desktop app is too old for both adding to a note and new notes.

clipGone.message: This selection is gone. Select the text again and right-click it.
clipGone.description: The note chooser was opened again after its selection was used or expired.

clipTooLong.message: The selection is too long for a note.
clipTooLong.description: Error: the selected text is over the size a note takes.

clipNoteFull.message: That note is full. Save the selection as a new note.
clipNoteFull.description: Error: the chosen secure note has reached its size limit.
